title: Wine Story: Same Wine, 10x Better Taste! Unbelievable (Adsy Talks ep. 11)
description:
🍷 Will you rank one bottle of wine the same? Or can a story behind the wine change your opinion?

One room tastes it cold: without context or story. Rates it a 4 or 5 out of 10. The other room meets the winemaker and hears about the soil, the vines, and the family that built this vineyard. 

Same wine gets poured. The winemaker leaves the room and everyone says the wine is 10 out of 10. 

In the end, you see a completely different brain experience. And that was not a trick or manipulation. That's what the story actually does to human beings – it physically changes how we process what we're experiencing. Your product isn't just what it is. It's everything you tell people about how it came to be. 

Want to learn more about SEO in the AI era, why solely traffic is a bad goal, and why great content is no longer enough? Then watch a full episode with Rand Fishkin, co-founder of Moz and Sparkoro and one of the most respected industry experts.
